Room.title: Room
Room.description: Public online game room state shared across room members without exposing secret words or roles during secret phases.

status.description: Current synchronized phase of the match.

spyCount.description: Number of spies configured for the round (1, 2, or 3).

winScore.description: Target score required to win the match.

questionCount.description: Number of questions asked in the current round.

currentAskerId.description: UID of the player currently asking the question.

currentAnswererId.description: UID of the player currently answering the question.

turnEventId.description: Unique event identifier preventing duplicate turn transitions.

memberUids.description: Bounded list of current room member UIDs (max 12).

maxPlayers.description: Maximum allowed players in the room (12).

isClosed.description: Whether the room is closed to new players.

revealedWord.description: Secret word populated ONLY after secret phases end (ROUND_RESULTS or MATCH_OVER).

revealedSpyIds.description: List of spy UIDs populated ONLY after secret phases end.

winnerIds.description: List of winning player UIDs when status reaches MATCH_OVER.

roundVotesSummary.description: Map of voterId to list of selectedSuspectIds populated at ROUND_RESULTS.

roundGuessesSummary.description: Map of spyId to guessedWord populated at ROUND_RESULTS.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of creation via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

RoomPlayer.title: RoomPlayer
RoomPlayer.description: Synchronized player profile, score, ready status, vote/guess completion flags, mic mute state, and presence inside a room.

memberUids.description: Denormalized room member UIDs for secure O(1) list queries.

name.description: Display name chosen by the player.

lastRoundScore.description: Points earned in the latest round.

hasConfirmedCard.description: True once the player taps 'تم' after viewing their secret role card.

hasVoted.description: True once the player submits their vote ballot in the current round.

hasGuessedWord.description: True once a spy submits their word guess in the current round.

isMicMuted.description: Live microphone mute status controlled exclusively by this player.

joinedOrder.description: Monotonic join index used for deterministic host migration.

PlayerSecret.title: PlayerSecret
PlayerSecret.description: Strictly isolated per-player secret role and word payload readable ONLY by the target player.

userId.description: Target player UID who alone may read this document.

hostId.description: Host UID who distributed the round secrets.

roundNumber.description: Round number this secret belongs to.

isSpy.description: Whether this player is a spy.

secretWord.description: The secret word for normal players, or empty string for spies.

spyOptions.description: 8-word guess list (correct word + 7 category distractors) populated for spies, empty for normal players.

RoundVault.title: RoundVault
RoundVault.description: Host-owned round master vault storing authoritative word and spy UIDs for scoring & host migration.

hostId.description: Host UID who created this round vault.

secretWord.description: Authoritative secret word for the round.

spyIds.description: Authoritative list of spy UIDs for the round.

scored.description: Idempotency flag preventing duplicate score calculation.

VoteBallot.title: VoteBallot
VoteBallot.description: Immutable per-round vote ballot cast by a player selecting suspected spies.

voterId.description: UID of the player casting the ballot.

selectedSuspectIds.description: Selected suspect UIDs matching the round spyCount.

createdAt.description: Immutable submission server timestamp via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

SpyWordGuess.title: SpyWordGuess
SpyWordGuess.description: Immutable independent secret word guess submitted by a spy.

spyId.description: UID of the spy submitting the guess.

createdAt.description: Immutable submission server timestamp via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

VoiceSignal.title: VoiceSignal
VoiceSignal.description: WebRTC SDP/ICE signaling packet scoped strictly between sender and recipient inside a room.

targetId.description: UID of the intended receiving peer.

createdAt.description: Signal creation server timestamp via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

UserMatchStat.title: UserMatchStat
UserMatchStat.description: Personal match history record stored under the authenticated user's profile.

playerCount.description: Number of players in the match.

/rooms/{roomCode}.description: Publicly joinable room document keyed by 6-char uppercase roomCode.

/rooms/{roomCode}/secrets/{playerId}.description: Per-player secret role and word payload.

/rooms/{roomCode}/vault/{roundId}.description: Authoritative round word and spies accessible only to current room host or after round ends.

/rooms/{roomCode}/signals/{signalId}.description: Peer-to-peer WebRTC voice chat signaling messages.
